tag: the comparator exits zero whatever the verdict
why: A round chaining on the comparison would read DIFFERENT or INCOMPLETE as agreement, which is how a parallel suite gets adopted on evidence that says the opposite.

tag: a declared difference swallows an undeclared one in the same run
why: The declaration mechanism exists so bar (b)1 is satisfiable at all, and its danger is exactly this: if everything becomes declared, SAME means nothing. The guard pairs a declared difference with a real one and requires the real one to survive.

tag: a truncated report is compared instead of refused
old: return {}, {"error": f"the report could not be parsed ({e.__class__.__name__}): {e}"}
why: pytest writes the junit file at the END of a run, so a STALLED run leaves nothing or a partial document. Comparing against that would adopt the parallel suite on evidence that does not exist.

tag: the detector loses the parallel denominator again
why: MEASURED in W539's proof: the parallel run wrote collected=null and run_verdict answered NOT KNOWN for a run that finished. Under xdist each worker collects its own shard, so the controller sees nothing — and FU-301's stalls are PARALLEL stalls, so this is precisely where blindness costs. THE BLIND ITSELF WAS CORRECTED: renaming the hook makes pytest error on an unknown hook name (exit 3), which is a BAD BLIND and measures nothing about the guard. The body is mutated instead, which leaves pytest able to run — the same mistake W537's blind set made and the reason BAD BLIND is a verdict rather than a failure.

tag: the serial hook clobbers the parallel total
why: On the controller of a parallel run session.items is empty, so writing it unconditionally turns a correct denominator established from the workers' ids back into nought.

tag: a declared difference carries no reason
old: SKIPS serially and PASSES in parallel, by design: the test asserts that each xdist worker owns its own store, and it calls pytest.skip when PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER is absent because there is then no worker to isolate from. This difference is correct, permanent, and the reason bar (b)1 needs a declaration mechanism rather than an identical-sets rule
why: A declaration is a CLAIM that a difference is correct. Without its reason recorded, the next round cannot tell a considered exemption from a convenient one, and the mechanism becomes a way to make any difference disappear.

tag: the federation seed goes back to an absolute receipt assertion
old: assert _received >= 500.0, ("the receiver's cycle took less than the transfer sent", _received)
why: FU-349. The absolute form passed serially and failed in parallel because the test's own sender's §12 reinvestment credits the receiver when the living-VSB registry is small enough for the pair to fall inside ventures.py's cap. One node blocked a 4.5x suite speedup; the guard must notice if it returns.

tag: the rhythm adopts the parallel suite but drops its completeness gate
why: The risk a proof creates is that its conclusion outlives its conditions. FU-301's stall is still unexplained, so adoption is only defensible while every parallel run is checked for completeness. Without the gate named in the rhythm, a later round reads 'use -n 6' and drops the half that makes it safe.
